title: Correct an assessment without losing open work
actor: A reviewer refining a recorded assessment
goal: Record an attributed current assessment correction while preserving unresolved findings and unrelated facts.
context: The reviewer has reassessed the stated scope and needs to correct the current assessment, including its limitations.
trigger: The reviewer submits the complete corrected assessment under the current Review task.
preconditions: The selected current-format report is complete and readable.
The reviewer has obtained its actual current contract/revision and the intended decision basis.

interaction.action: Supplies the complete corrected assessment and explicit current revision, optionally previewing the task.
Returns a bounded preview of the intended changes without saving or reserving the state.
Explicitly submits the intended update for publication.
Validates the combined candidate, preserves omitted findings and unrelated facts, and reports the actual storage result.

expected_outcome: The current assessment reflects the explicit reviewer submission; omitted findings survive and dependent reliance is reconciled rather than silently renewed.

alternatives.condition: The entire submitted candidate is unchanged and current preconditions hold.
alternatives.outcome: Report unchanged without advancing the semantic revision.

alternatives.condition: The reviewer also explicitly decides to change applicability.
alternatives.outcome: The owning task can publish the explicitly supplied applicability decision with the explanation change without inferring it from prose.

failures.condition: The expected revision changed or the assessment shape contains unknown or incomplete fields.
failures.outcome: Reject or conflict without inventing assessment values or silently retargeting the correction.

failures.condition: The update overlaps another assignment in the same task submission.
failures.outcome: The whole candidate rejects rather than silently choosing one actor value.
